L01.rationale: Validation deliberately does not parse commands. A declared runtime with a verbatim probe and a canary ancestor exercises the command interface before the real work.

L02.rationale: swarm.py continue --repoint-dependents repoints dependents and maps the tracker draft.

L03.rationale: Review rounds are budgeted per logical unit across continuations with a round ledger, and research mode bounds rounds and lets the orchestrator overrule findings outside the hard-block list.
